name: Republic of Aurelia
description: A fictional country that puts most of its food-system money into roads, market places, storage, processing and irrigation, with thin funding for research, animal systems, environment and finance. About a quarter of indicator gaps are imputed and the envelope grows by about two thirds over six years. Synthetic demonstration data.
